name: HCP Plastene Bulkpack Limited
summary: HCP Plastene Bulkpack Limited provides plastic packaging solutions in India. It operates in two segments, Woven Sack and Woven Label. It provides flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC) bags and liners, and AD star bags; technical textiles; polypropylene (PP) woven bags and sacks; and biaxially oriented polypropylene bags. The company also offers PP Febric, PP webbing, multi filament yarn, and PP Yarn, as well as small and jumbo bags, and Jaquard Labels. It exports its products. The company serves its products to the cement, sugar, food grains, and fertilizer industries. The company was formerly known as Gopala Polyplast Limited and changed its name to HCP Plastene Bulkpack Limited in October 2021. HCP Plastene Bulkpack Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
